maria (CS): Quick weekly check — flagged hosted spend vs commit for AcmeCorp. Dashboard shows 2.3x week-over-week increase and an anomaly flag on 2472001200. Anyone seeing obvious config changes?
ajay (CS): seeing the same. top client_key = ck_live_abc123, 98% of tokens from embedding calls last night. :eyes:
billing-bot: ALERT: Hosted spend threshold breached for account AcmeCorp (commit= $10k/month, current 7-day burn=$11.5k).
jules (acct): Confirmed they renewed last quarter. Renewal in 60 days — we should avoid surprise overages.
sam (eng): I ran the quick query: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM requests WHERE acct='acmecorp' AND ts>2471990000` returns 2.1M tokens; most are long embedding batches. Stacktrace shows repeated retries from `embed_batcher`.
maria (CS): Thanks Sam — can you paste the retry logs? If it's a job misconfiguration we can recommend backoff + smaller batch_size.
sam (eng): Paste: ```2026-03-18T23:12:02Z embed_batcher ERROR retrying batch size=5000 status=429```
ajay (CS): 5000 batch size is way above our Optimize suggestion. Recommend batch_size=512 and enable `auto-chunking` in their client.
tara (CS): I'll draft a short note with recommended config + cost impact estimate. Want me to include a suggested rollout plan to lower peak by ~60%?
maria (CS): yes. Also flag for billing to hold further auto-invoices until we confirm with account.
jules (acct): Please also add a note about potential renewal impact if costs spike; I'll loop in AM to present mitigation during next call.
billing-bot: NOTE: Temporary invoice hold requested for AcmeCorp by maria (CS). Action required: Billing ops to acknowledge.
ajay (CS): Quick mitigation script to suggest to customer:
```
client.batch_size = 512
client.retry_backoff = 0.5
client.parallelism = 4
```
maria (CS): Action items:
- Tara: draft message + config snippet + expected $$ reduction (due EOD) 
- Sam: dig into retries and check if our gateway sent 429s or upstream model had limits (due EOD)
- Jules: notify AM + flag renewal risk in CRM (low -> medium until resolved)
- Billing ops: acknowledge hold and confirm if any contractual remedies exist

tara (CS): on it. will attach charts showing token distribution and projected monthly spend.
ajay (CS): FYI I'll follow up with a quick enablement guide we can paste into the message.
maria (CS): Perfect. If we can get them to reduce batch size and enable chunking, we should be back under commit within 24-48h. :thumbsup: 
jules (acct): Thanks team — looping AM. keeping this in next weekly health sync.
sam (eng): noted, will post any infra findings in thread.
maria (CS): closing note: tagging docs page https://redwood.ai/docs/optimize/batching for reference.
